dict.string: IntelyIDE lists the folders on your Desktop so you can choose a Git repository to open. It does not change anything there.
IntelyIDE lists the folders in Documents so you can choose a Git repository to open. It does not change anything there.
IntelyIDE lists the folders in Downloads so you can choose a Git repository to open. It does not change anything there.
IntelyIDE lists the folders on external drives so you can choose a Git repository to open. It does not change anything there.
IntelyIDE lists the folders on network drives so you can choose a Git repository to open. It does not change anything there.
